contract_revisions.reason: Relative entrance position is optional and not used by the three requested form checks. The model preserves the confirmed front-left statement in evidence and passes visibility/direct-line/backing; omission is not fabricated or stale geometry. Requiring redundant optional fields would reward maximal inputs rather than correct minimal calculation.

The initial audit could pass missing results, extra schema arguments, later invented array members and unrelated FateBridge business calls. Contracts now explicitly permit tools, count every factual array and bind every supplied fact (unknown is neither null nor false). Schema and receipt checks are shared, answer review stays independent. Confirmed nonessential fields are if-present checks; the previous redundant entrance-position false-fail reason and original audits remain preserved.

Exhaustive metadata added from both user prompts: same female with unchanged 1985-08-23 birth date and one bed, one occupant; only head SW is replaced by S in turn 2. Cross-purpose role headboard derives from fixed bed purpose. Unknown house orientation, bed palace and birth hour remain forbidden. Object/subject IDs are free model identities; runtime checks references. No extra collections or unsupported tools allowed. Original reports and human review remain untouched.
